summary: Dialogflow CX route groups can be scoped at the flow level or the agent level.
extended_definition: Dialogflow CX route groups can be scoped at the flow level or the agent level.

supporting_pages.title: Flows \_|\_ Dialogflow CX \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Agent-level route groups referenced by a locked flow or any page under a locked flow cannot be deleted, but they can still be edited.
Flow-level route groups cannot be created, edited, deleted.
For details, see State handler scope and Flow-level routes .
